binding_readiness.notes: No foreign-language interfaces are implemented yet. Milestone 12 targets a stable C ABI and Python module for high-level archive operations, configuration, error mapping, FEC, streaming, and transport-oriented wrappers. Milestone 13 targets Swift/iOS and Kotlin/Java/Android after ownership, callback, cancellation, secret-handling, and packaging contracts stabilize.

items.name: ArchiveReader::read_all_logical_files
items.signature: pub fn ArchiveReader<R>::read_all_logical_files(&mut self, allow_lossy: bool) -> Result<Vec<LogicalFile>, SarError>
items.description: High-level bounded extraction: reads all entries, assembles fragment groups via reconstruct_fragments, applies sparse zero-fill via apply_sparse_reconstruction, and returns LogicalFile values. Resets the read cursor so it can be called even after prior next_entry calls. When allow_lossy is false (default), a missing fragment returns FragmentGap. When allow_lossy is true and LOSS_TOLERANT is set, degraded output is returned with LogicalFile::is_degraded = true. AEAD and format errors are never suppressed. Sparse reconstruction uses LFH Uncompressed Size as the final logical file size; trailing holes are filled with 0x00. Empty Areas (Name Length == 0, IS_FRAGMENT == 0) are excluded from the returned list.
items.ffi_notes: High-value FFI candidate; Vec<LogicalFile> ownership needs care.

commands.name: create
commands.usage: sar create <input> <output.sar> [--indexed|--no-index] [--compression store|deflate|zstd | -S | -z | -Z] [--compression-level 0..9 | -0..-9] [--encrypt aes256-gcm|xchacha20-poly] [--password PASSWORD] [--fec xor|rs]
commands.description: Create an archive from a file or directory tree with optional compression, password-based encryption, and per-entry Selective FEC.

options.name: --password
options.description: Explicit archive password; only valid when `--encrypt` is set.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text

commands.notes: Passwords fall back to `SAR_PASSWORD` and then an interactive prompt when encryption is enabled.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extract an archive into a destination directory with traversal protection.

options.name: --password
options.description: Explicit archive password for encrypted archives.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text

commands.notes: Rejects absolute paths and parent-directory traversal in entry names.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspect archive metadata and FEC summaries in plaintext or JSON form.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text

commands.notes: Implemented for unencrypted archives and current FEC metadata; no password option exists for encrypted inspect flows.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List archive entries with compression name and size information.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text

commands.notes: Works for unencrypted archives and current FEC archives, but lacks a password option for encrypted archives.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify archive structure, indexed offsets, and current recovery-TLV metadata.

options.name: --password
options.description: Explicit archive password for encrypted archives.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text

commands.notes: No dedicated repair workflow is exposed; verification is structural and metadata-oriented.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the crate version plus SAR spec and central-dictionary version markers.

exit_codes.meaning: failure; stderr includes SAR status text
